summary: Post-deadline agenda consolidation (round 12). Honest answer: nothing reaches R8 (27 Sep 12:00 UTC); finals stay #37 + #38. The combo oracle (+0.0143 joint like-for-like, realistic +0.0004 in-sample, <= 0 out-of-sample) and the round-11 ceilings rule out every rule-based fork, orphan or link post-process on x138. Even a perfect linker is +0.0011 lab without swaps, and the swaps are GT jumps or offset detections. Only the detector/localisation program (I-113 + I-261 + I-110, applied to the SECONDARY because the V1284 head reads primary features) has a ceiling above the +0.012 bar (missing-node pool <= +0.029). The learned far-daughter slot (I-079) needs AUC >= ~0.94 from today's 0.77. Ranked agenda by EV per cost unit (GPU-h + 0.25 x eng-h): (1) a new zero-cost private transfer table over all 39 old submissions (pre-register now, before 29 Sep 23:59); (2) a late-submission bed check on 30 Sep (the only real embryo-held-out bed for inference-only items, 0 GPU); (3) I-222 guard counterfactual (2.0e-4/unit, sign confounded); (4) D0 CPU separability test (merged vs dim) to choose nnPU vs de-merge; (5) I-242 post-freeze re-solve (0.9e-4); (6) the D program (0.9e-4, EV +0.002 lab, the only real bet); (7) coordhead-v2 (0.7e-4); (8) I-079 learned slot (0.6e-4); (9) I-122 Trackastra (0.17e-4); (10) I-285 hook (enabler only); (11) I-208 stays stopped. Gates are pre-registered now: G0, with paired retrain (arm vs same-recipe control, both embryo directions, 6bba-test bootstrap lower bound > 0, node count within 1%) and at most one late sub per item (budget 15). Every item has a kill criterion.

findings.what: WHAT THE COMBO ORACLE AND THE ROUND-11 CEILINGS RULE OUT FOR AFTER 29 SEP (base ins35 = K2 minus lowrefine, ALL 0.93988, div 25/31/74, J 0.1923; W ~41.8k edges; one edge flip ~2.4e-5, one division TP ~7.7e-4 to 9.2e-4). (a) ANY RULE-BASED OR GEOMETRIC post-processing of x138's fixed nodes in the fork-removal, orphan-attach or linking families, alone or combined. The like-for-like joint oracle is +0.01428, only 1.19x the +0.012 bar. A realistic method would have to capture ~84% of the oracle edits with no new errors, i.e. classifiers at AUC ~0.94 on both edit classes (m_transfer binormal: AUC 0.73 -> +0.00025, AUC 0.90 -> +0.0036/+0.0051, AUC 0.95 -> +0.0061/+0.0092). This kills the GEOMETRIC form of I-079 (<= 7/62 pass its gates; mirror attach precision 3.4% vs q* 0.161) and any post-deadline 'combined rider'. (b) THE LINKER AS A SCORE LEVER (I-122 Trackastra, relink-family arms enabled by I-285, stitch, gap LAP, swapfix). The no-swap link oracle is +0.00106 on the whole bed and the dangling-end ceiling is +0.0032. The swap share (~+0.006, 129-136 edges) is a GT identity jump or offset detection (v sits 1.59 um from w, 7.30 um from u), so no linker can take it; if anything can, it is detection or localisation. Even a perfect linker is therefore < +0.0005 public at 1/6. (c) Fork removal: oracle +0.0063 (isolated FP forks ~+0.0033). (d) Node recall by post-processing (raw maxima, readmit/gapfill/lowdet knobs): ceiling +0.0059 at zero cost, realistic ~-0.03. (e) Division-wave prior (4.2% of within-clip pairs at dt <= 2) and every metric lever (the node-drop bonus pays only at P(annotated) < ~0.2%). WHAT SURVIVES: only the detector/localisation program has a ceiling above the bar. The missing-node pool is <= +0.029 (1,211 FN edge-ends x 2.4e-5). The swap share could be reachable through localisation. Division recall is reachable only through a LEARNED classifier at AUC >= ~0.94 (I-079 learned slot; wide attach oracle +0.020 with 26 TP).

findings.what: CONSOLIDATED POST-DEADLINE AGENDA (for after 29 Sep; no build now). Ranked by expected value per cost unit. EV = P(pass the pre-registered gate) x lab gain if it passes. Cost unit = GPU-h + 0.25 x engineer-hours (floor 0.5). Public ~ lab x r, with r in [0, 1/6] until R12P-2 re-measures it. Bar for a 'score lever' claim: lab >= 0.002/r (= +0.012 at r = 1/6). Anything smaller is recorded as learning only. GLOBAL GATE G0 (fixed now). There are only 2 train embryos (44b6 = 71 overlapping crops of ONE recording, the public dorado movie, 26 divisions; 6bba = 128 clips, 125 divisions), and every public weight (pilkwang primary/secondary, V1284 head, edge net, DeepCenter partly) saw both. So no leak-free baseline exists for the x138 stack. Hence: (i) INFERENCE-ONLY items on the frozen x138 stack: one pre-declared arm, knobs fixed before any score, exp60 lab (56 clips, leak-group clip bootstrap), then exactly ONE late submission if late subs exist (R12P-3). (ii) TRAINED items: PAIRED RETRAIN (R12P-4). Arm and control use the same recipe and seed schedule, are trained on embryo A and scored on embryo B, in both directions. PASS iff delta > 0 in both directions AND the leak-group bootstrap 90% lower bound > 0 in the 6bba-test direction (the only direction with division power: 44b6 exp60 has 11 GT divisions, 2 TP / 8 FP forks, 0 orphan TPs). Knobs come from inner CV on the training embryo only. One pre-declared fallback arm at most. No public or private knob ladders. #1 R12P-2 PRIVATE TRANSFER TABLE over ALL old submissions (P1-P38). Cost 0 GPU, ~2 eng-h (unit 0.5). No score, but it re-sets r and so the bar for every item below. #2 R12P-3 LATE-SUBMISSION BED CHECK on 30 Sep. Cost 0 GPU (hidden reruns do not use our quota), ~1 eng-h. If enabled, it is the only real embryo-held-out bed for inference-only items. #3 I-222 RETENTION-GUARD COUNTERFACTUAL (inference only). Mechanism: the guard swaps the 0.80-weight blend for primary-only when blended candidates < 0.90 x primary: 44b6 33.1% / 6bba 3.9% of frames. Gain arithmetic: the FN-rate gap between all-primary and all-blended clips is 6.43 - 4.16 = 2.27 pp. If causal, 44b6 edge FN falls by 0.331 x 2.27 = 0.75 pp (~+0.0075 adj edge on 44b6) and 6bba by 0.039 x 2.27 = 0.09 pp (~+0.0009). It is confounded, though: the guard fires exactly when the blend lost >= 10% of candidates, so guard-off can lose recall. Range -0.003..+0.003 lab; P(pass) 0.3; EV +0.0006; cost 2 GPU-h (6 clips x 3 arms x ~0.4 h) + 4 eng-h = 3 units -> 2.0e-4/unit. Hidden runtime: ~0 (guard off removes one pass). Gate: the pre-declared primary arm is guard-off (fallback: weight 0.475). exp60 on the 6 named clips PLUS all 17 44b6 clips; same sign on both embryos and 44b6 delta >= +0.002; then one late sub, where private delta >= +0.001 vs #37 at 3 dp. Kill: 44b6 delta <= 0, or a node-count change > 3% carries the gain (node-bias lesson, I-146). Main value is explaining the shake-up (embryo-dependent fallback 33% vs 4%). #4 D0 DETECTOR-TARGET SEPARABILITY (CPU; decides I-113 vs a de-merge target; R12P-5). Cost 0 GPU, ~4 eng-h (unit 1). It is a decision gate that protects ~20 GPU-h in #6. #5 I-242 POST-FREEZE RE-SOLVE (CPU replay from the exp60 presafe dump; geometric/flow cost only, never ILP or edge-net trust). Ceiling +0.0063 (6bba only; excess 120 FN + 152 FP on 248 frozen transitions). The fixed-node non-swap link oracle is +0.0011 for the whole bed and efpost measured +0.0017, so the realistic range is +0.0005..+0.002 lab on 6bba-like embryos x P(hidden embryos have freezes) ~0.5 (0/17 44b6 clips freeze). P(pass) 0.35; EV ~+0.00018; cost 0 GPU + 8 eng-h = 2 -> 0.9e-4/unit. Hidden runtime ~1-2 s/clip. Gate: pre-declared cost function; 6bba leak-free clip-group 2-fold (SELECTION odd / CONFIRMATION even stems) with delta > 0 on both halves; > 50% of the gain must come from added or reassigned TP edges, not dropped FP edges (edge-filter lesson I-161); then one late sub. Kill: CONFIRMATION delta <= +0.0005, or the gain is edge dropping only. #6 D1-D2 DETECTOR PROGRAM = I-113 (nnPU / ignore-unlabelled) + I-261 (detector training target) + I-110 (dense pseudo-labels with teacher edges) as ONE program, applied to the SECONDARY first. R10-RC-B: the V1284 head reads PRIMARY features, so a primary swap fails silently; the secondary carries weight 0.80 in the blend. Gain arithmetic: the missing-node pool is <= +0.029 (1,211 FN edge-ends x 2.4e-5). Recovering 20-30% of it at a node-neutral count gives +0.006..+0.009, and localisation could add part of the ~+0.006 swap share. Risk: our retrains lost (secondary scratch 0.920 = -0.025; fine-tuned secondary 0.937; Canh encoder-only -0.038). Range -0.01..+0.01 lab; P(pass) 0.25; EV +0.002, the largest absolute EV and the only item whose ceiling exceeds the bar. Outside evidence: top 0.975-0.978 vs our 0.954, and y3uanm's teacher-distilled secondary 0.949 -> 0.956. Cost ~20 GPU-h (4 paired fine-tunes x ~1 h at 2.05 s/it + held-out scoring ~4 x 3 h) + 10 eng-h = 22.5 -> 0.9e-4/unit. Hidden runtime 0 (same architecture). Gate: G0 paired retrain, BOTH directions, scored on missing-run recall at an equal node count (+-1%) AND the official metric; lab delta >= bar. Kill: control-vs-arm delta <= 0 in either direction, OR node count +> 3% (node-bias lesson), OR held-out delta < +0.004 after 2 recipes. #7 COORDHEAD-v2 = I-261 axial part + I-029 learned per-video z. Arithmetic: constant +0.1 vox z gave +0.0016 in-sample (44b6 +0.0025, 6bba +0.0015), but the residual bias differs by embryo (0.15 vs 0.45 um), so the honest per-embryo size is +0.0003..+0.0005. The single-frame re-localisation target sandwich_through = 27 nodes = +0.0013. Range 0..+0.002 lab; P(pass) 0.3 (the head retrain already failed this exact test: 6bba->44b6 +12.0%); EV +0.00036; cost 3 GPU-h (sharded capture) + 8 eng-h = 5 -> 0.7e-4/unit. Hidden runtime 0. Gate: embryo-held-out distance improves in BOTH directions AND exp60 delta > 0 per embryo. Kill: either direction worse than the public head. #8 I-079 LEARNED FAR-DAUGHTER SLOT (DaughterNet v3 with a far-daughter 8-12 um head; the geometric form is dead, r12p-1). Arithmetic: gated attach oracle +0.0054 (7 TP, all 6bba), wide +0.020 (26 TP). The binormal model gives ~+0.002 for the attach class alone at AUC 0.90. Current OOF daughter AUC is 0.767 (parent 0.848) and the measured cues 0.73, so it needs +0.13..+0.18 AUC from 151 divisions. Range 0..+0.004 lab; P(pass) 0.1-0.15; EV +0.00036; cost 3 GPU-h + 12 eng-h = 6 -> 0.6e-4/unit. Hidden runtime <= +0.1 h (the insertion costs <= 0.85 h). Gate: 6bba grouped 5-fold OOF far-daughter AUC >= 0.90 on the orphan pool, evaluable fork precision > q* = 0.161 on the K2 stack, 44b6 delta >= 0; then one late sub. Kill: OOF AUC < 0.90 or precision <= 0.161. #9 I-122 TRACKASTRA ZERO-SHOT RE-SCORE of relink pairs (pretrained 'ctc'). Ceiling +0.0011 (no-swap) / +0.0032 (dangling). Range +0.0002..+0.001; P 0.15; EV +0.00012; cost 3 GPU-h + 16 eng-h (pseudo-masks, offline wheel) = 7 -> 0.17e-4/unit. Hidden runtime unknown (+1.5-5 h would eat most of the 4.5 h headroom over K2's 7.5 h). Kill: pre-registered at once. Fund it only as a learning exercise, and only after #6 is closed. #10 I-285 PRE-RELINK DUMP HOOK + leak-group OOF edge net: an enabler with no direct gain (the linker ceiling is +0.0011). findings.what: R12P-4 PAIRED-RETRAIN GATE for every training item (I-113, I-110, I-261/I-029 coordhead-v2, I-079 learned slot). Problem: comparing a retrained model with the public weights on a held-out embryo is biased, because the public weights saw both embryos (and 44b6 = dorado crops, so dorado-pretrained models also leak). Our only kill test so far (head retrain 6bba->44b6 +12.0%) mixed 'our recipe is worse' with 'the public weights are leaky'. Design: control = the same recipe WITHOUT the change, trained on the same embryo with the same seeds; the arm differs only by the change. Score both on the other embryo in both directions; decide on the arm-minus-control delta. Cost: roughly doubles training GPU (~+4-8 GPU-h per item), and prevents the in-sample and leaky-baseline traps that produced 0 of 5 transfers for the other classes. Pre-registered pass: delta > 0 in both directions; leak-group bootstrap 90% lower bound > 0 in the 6bba-test direction; an equal node count within +-1% (or node-matched thresholds); lab delta >= 0.002/r to claim a score lever.

findings.what: R12P-5 = D0 DETECTOR-TARGET SEPARABILITY TEST (CPU, ~4 eng-h, before any detector GPU). It decides whether I-113 nnPU (cause = dim or unlabelled) or a de-merge target (cause = crowding) gets the ~20 GPU-h. Facts: 6bba misses are mostly not dim (72% vs 87% above the intensity threshold) but peakless (31% vs 70% have a raw local max within 5 um); 80% are multi-frame runs. Test on exp60 (56 clips, raw zarr + final graphs): for each missing GT node and a matched-GT control, take the thresholded raw connected component around it and the nearest final node at 3-9 um. Features: component volume / median singleton volume, principal-axis elongation, 2-peak DoG score along the major axis. Pre-registered read: MERGED if >= 50% of misses vs <= 15% of controls sit in components > 1.6x the singleton volume, and the AUC of (volume, elongation) for miss vs control >= 0.70. Then D1 = a de-merge target: a higher-resolution centre heatmap (x138's detector outputs at XY ds 4x = 1.625 um/voxel), or an instance-aware / neighbourhood-softmax peak loss (I-113's second half), trained on the SECONDARY. DIM if the misses' peak prominence is below the 10th percentile of controls in >= 50% of cases: D1 = nnPU / ignore-unlabelled loss. NEITHER (AUC < 0.60): kill the detector-recall branch and move the GPU to I-110 distillation (teacher edges). Expected value: it shifts P(pass) of the D program from ~0.2 to ~0.3 on the chosen branch, or saves ~20 GPU-h.

findings.what: I-222 SIGN CORRECTION for the agenda text: the LESSONS s4 wording 'sign unknown' is right, but round 3's FN rates (primary-only 10.71% vs blended 3.17% in mixed clips) must NOT be read as 'the guard costs recall'. The guard fires exactly when the blended candidate count falls below 0.90 x primary, i.e. when the 0.80-weight blend has already lost >= 10% of detections. The fallback frames are selected hard frames, so guard-off can LOSE recall there. The clip-level gap (all-primary 6.43% vs all-blended 4.16%) is confounded in the same way. Upper bound if causal: ~+0.0075 adj edge on 44b6 and ~+0.0009 on 6bba. Lower bound: recall lost on 33% of 44b6 frames. Hence the pre-registered same-sign-on-both-embryos gate plus 44b6 >= +0.002, and a late sub rather than a lab-only verdict.
